name: apple-notes
title: Apple Notes clone
description: Apple Notes for your Markdown files, with the Docstream rich editor. Add multiple folders under On My Mac; their handles are remembered across reloads. Each sidebar location is its own master list in a NavigationStack: folders push, file leaves open the note. The top-right control switches to the library's file Tree. Right-click any folder, note or location to rename, duplicate or delete it in place. Includes OPFS personal notes, autosave, native document properties, task state icons and menus, folder-backed live examples, unseen external-edit blue dots and conflict recovery. Starts with no sample content. Responsive SplitView on desktop, tablet and phone.
